4372b37694b08ae56c81f13508114de417e4dabf:
query FlxAnalyticsRefs($filter: FlxAnalyticsFilterInput) {
  flxAnalyticsRefs(filter: $filter) {
    ...FlxAnalyticsRefFields
  }
}

fragment FlxAnalyticsRefFields on FlxAnalyticsRef {
  code
  name
  label
  url
  visitors
  pageviews
  sessions
  pagesPer
  avgDuration
  donations
  amount
  deepest
  deepestLabel
  completed
}
